snippet.title: O3 - Hollow Descent  - Kickstarter Coming Soon -
snippet.description:
O3 - Hollow Descent  New Gameplay Trailer HD 1080p

Dive into O3 - Hollow Descent, a bullet-hell roguelike shooter set in a surreal universe inspired by the haunting art of H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński. As a lone astronaut stranded on a hostile planet, navigate ever-changing rooms filled with deadly traps and malevolent creatures. Uncover ancient ruins, confront intelligent life forms, and unravel the mysteries that lie within.

Kickstarter Coming Soon: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ta2gamesstudio/03-a-surreal-roguelike-journey-into-the-unknown

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528960/O3__Hollow_Descent/
